book.title: LUK Kamambuno Wakai Luk Muno Boglkwa

content: Yesus andigl ukor ongwa
Sande enge tangina kinde kana ambu wagle taragl demine orkwa akekun ere yeingwa indre ana ende kombuglo dra Yesus pandiglmara dumo eingwa.
Ana ye kanigwa kombuglo dra mina kombuglo siget-dingwa ikra berandi eglke endingwa pango,
ana ye ende suna eingwa, ba Yaglkande Yesus nangiye briye pango kankrikwa.
Ye ipre kinano gundo igle andigl meglko ana oglandi kaima yagl suwo gatno suna kruwo mundu pango ye meglmara mangigl igle andigl miurka.
Ambu wagle kundugl pond gogl ana mangidi gumano kan makandle endingwa, ba yagl suwo i ditembrika, “Ene sraglpre yomba kor-moglkwa ye pre geglkwa mina dokime?
Ye yawagle ta pai moglkrukwa. Ye andigl ukor ongwa! Ye Galili kamun mogl pangwa enge, ka sragl we ditongwa, i ene piryo,
‘Yomba Wam tekoglo tandaglme erikwa yomba mina endimbi ana endi-prak mina sigoraglkwa, ana ande enge suwota eran andigl ukor enambuka.’”
Ana ambu wagle Yesus ka okuna dungwa ikra poglodi pirkwa.
Ana ye kombuglo dra kondo ende ikine pindre, ana taragl i prapra disaipelmo 11 wagle ya yomba tau akiye diteingwa.
Ana Maria Makdala kamun mam ya, Joana ya, Jems mam Maria ya, te ambu tau ye bogl akiye eingwa i ye taragl orko kanigwa i di aposel wagle teingwa.
Ba aposel wagle ambu ka dingwa i pir gidikrikwa. Sraglpre, ye kayoko dimedi pirkwa.

Ba Pita andigltre ana mukundi ende kombuglo dra ongwa. Ana ye goinge ere kan kombuglo dra endungwa igle gagl alap were teingwa i keunde yongo kangwa. Ana ye ende ikine yungugl pindre, ana taragl kangwa ikra pre nomane sungun prukwa.
Yagl suwo ende Emeus kamun ena pre pindre Yesus kambrika
Ana ande enge suwara i keunde disaipelmo mina yagl suwo ende yungu epigl kangiye Emeus we dimara igle embrika, ana Jerusalem yei ende dumo igle enaglkwa 11 kilomita yongwa.
Ana yaglmo suwo konbauna ende pindre, ana taragl prapra plau dungwa ikra pre yene dipir embrika.
Ye ka i di imboriya ende pir embriko, ana Yesus ye yene embirara wu suna ongo akiye eingwa.
Ba ye suwo ongumutno ake kumbugl kambugl orko ana Yesus umedi ta kanpogl sikiurka.
Yesus krapogl tongwa, “Ene sragl taragl pre denbi di imbor ya ende umbre?” Ye andigl diglkindi miurko ana gumano drano wu kinde ongwa.
Ana yaglmo suwo i ta kangiye Kliopas we dingwa, ye krapogl tongwa, “Ene suwara yomba kor ta Jerusalem kamun suna ungwa. Ana enge igle taragl prapra egliro plau dungwa i ene kankitn kana?”

Ana ye krapogl tongwa, “Sragl taragl ne?” Ye di ikine endimbrika, “Yesus Nasaret kamun nem ye mina taragl plau dungwa. Ye propet ta moglkwa. Ana God ya yomba prapra ongumutno mina ka dungwa ya kongun orkwa i yombuglo pond pangwa.
Pris kande wagle ya nono kaungo yomba ye tekoglo endingo ana gavman pra gorambe dungo, ana Yesus endi-prak mina singwa.
Ana ye suwara Israel yomba toposi ikine endinambedi no okuna yegl punga, ba ka ta ama pangwa i taragl prapra plau dingura i erme ande enge suwota orkwa.
Ana no epitno mina ambu tau no sipuglo dinamga ka dingwa. Ana erme tangina kana kombuglo dra pandiglmara eingwa.
Ba Yesus nangiye briye pango kankrikwa, ye ende ikine undre dinerikwa, no ongumutno-mugl orko kamga angelo suwo yegl dimbrika, ‘Yesus andigl ukor ongwa.’
Ana no akiye nigle i wamga tau ende kombuglo dra pi doko kanigwa, ama ambu dimere yeglkra kuno orkwa, ba ye Yesus kankrikwa.”
Yesus di yagl suwo tongwa, “Ene du eur kana, propet okuna ka prapra dingwa i kra ene nomano mina suna paikruko, ana pirngidi kiurika!
Krais geu prapra goglkran ana okuwo ende God ambuglangemo mina suna enambuka kuno orumo?”
Ana ye mambuno bogl Moses ya propet wagle prapra ka okuna muno beglko pangwa i yene pre dipene ende yagl suwo tekondungwa.
Ana ye kamun ta enambugledi embirara igle ye mangigl eingo, Yesus ama konbauna tau ende eglke dagl ena mere orkwa.
Ba ye manedi akegi dindre, dimbrika, “Ene no bogl moramna, sraglpre, ande beingo mim era orkwa.” Ana ye bogl akiye moraglkwa pre ende yungugl ongwa.
Ana Yesus eremogl ye akiye bogl mina amedi meglko, ana bret indre God diwakai yeite, ana bukondi yagl suwo tongwa.
Ana ye ongumutno pirkam dungo, Yesus kanpogl simbriko ana oglandi ye ongumutno-mugl i-mimdaglkwa.
Ana ye yene di imboriya endimbrika, “Ye nono bogl konbauna akiye umgo, ana kamambuno okuna muno beglko pamara igle di yauro norko, ana nono nomano mina donga mereyegl dekrutuno?”
Ana ye tambre kana andigl ende ikine Jerusalem embrika. Eglire pindre ana kambriko disaipel 11 wagle ya yomba tau ye akiye waningwa bogl makaisi meglko,
ana dingwa, “I kaima! Yaglkande andigl ukor pindre, ana Saimon Pita moglmara wu nongugl pi tongwa.”
Ana yagl suwo konbauna bange taragl orkwa ikra ya, te ye bret buko dungwa enge i ye kanpogl simbrika ikra boglo kiurika.
Yesus disaipelma wagle meglmara plau ditongwa
Ana ye ka i boglo kugl miurko, ana Yesus yene disaipelma wagle meglmara suna igle andigl mogltre, ana ditongwa, “Nomano pokndi ene mina yenano.”
Ana ye sipuglo dindre, kundugl pond gogl ye gigl ta kanmunedi pirkwa.
Ba Yesus disaipelma wagle ditongwa, “Ene sraglpre sipuglodi nomano suwo yeme?
Na onguna ya katna mina kaniyo. I na, nana! Na kandre ana ake piryo, na nangina pango ene kanigwa yeglmere, ana gigl ta nangino ya te yomburo ta panan kankraglkwa.”
Ana ye ka yegl dindre, ana ongo ya kagle ye ombuno ditongwa.
Ana ye gun kaima yeingwa ba nomano kugl ongo ana pirngidi dikrikwa. Yeglpre ye krapogl tongwa, “Ana taragl ninaglkwa ta igle yeimbi yomo?”
Ana ye fis gaiglko dongwa ikine ta i teingwa.
Ana ye pra indre kanmeglko nongwa.

Okuwo Yesus di ye tongwa, “Na ene bogl akiye wanmounga enge, ka i ene diteinga, na mina sragl i prapra wu giu dinambuka i Moses lomo mina ya propet wagle kanno mina ya te kamambuno giglange mina ka muno beglko pangwa.”
Ana kamambuno mina okuna muno beglko pangwa i ye pirpogl sinaglkwa pre, Yesus nomano ake audi tendre
ana ditongwa, “Kamambuno mina muno yegl beglko pangwa Krais giu gogltre, ana ande enge suwota eran andigl ukor enambuka.
Ana ye kangiye mina Jerusalem mambuno bogl kamambuno dipene ende dumo kamun koglkoglo embi ana yomba nomano yake tembi ana God tandaglmeno kindekondo tenambuka.
Ana ene taragl orkwa i prapra diwai dinaglkwa.
Ana na Nina okuna taragl ene tenagledi ka dipanduglkwa ikra na di ene mina endinaglka. Yeglpre ene siti sugl kan meglmbi kamun mitna yombuglo ende atne ene mina unambuka.”
God eremogl Yesus yend heven ongwa
Yesus eremogl dumo kande kondo disaipelma wagle auro yend Betani kamun mangigl pindre, ana igle yene ongo mitna ende ana ere wakai ere tongwa.
Ye ere wakai ere temoglko, ana God eremogl Yesus yend heven suna ongo ana disaipelma wagle kondungwa.
Ana ye dembiye karaugl ere tendre, gun argan bogl ende ikine Jerusalem eingwa.
Ye ende ikine Jerusalem pindre, ana God holi yungumo mina yungugl mogltre, God dembiye engenge site meglkwa.
